nodes.neumann_archetype: the divine child reborn through the waters of the Great Mother, death-and-rebirth through immersion in the oceanic unconscious

nodes.name: Paean
nodes.physical_characteristics: epithet of Apollo as healer, or a separate healing deity
nodes.significant_event: the healing song addressed to Apollo, used as a title for Apollo in his capacity as divine physician
nodes.symbolism: the identity between the healing god and the song of praise addressed to him, Apollo as the god whose music heals
nodes.neumann_archetype: the solar masculine as healer through song, the Apolline principle of healing through harmony

nodes.name: Inachus
nodes.domain: rivers, Argos, kingship, the first river
nodes.physical_characteristics: river god and first king of Argos
nodes.significant_event: judged the contest between Hera and Poseidon for patronage of Argos, chose Hera, Poseidon punished him by drying up his river, father of Io
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Oceanus and Tethys, the oldest river god of the Argolid
nodes.death_circumstances: The historian Pausanias describes him as the eldest king of Argos who named the river after himself and sacrificed to Hera.
nodes.symbolism: the river-king who chooses the Great Goddess over the sea god and is punished with drought, the first sovereign as a flowing presence
nodes.neumann_archetype: the river father who chooses the Great Mother (Hera) and suffers the masculine gods retribution, the primordial flowing king

nodes.name: Kratos
nodes.physical_characteristics: powerful divine figure, enforcer of Zeus will
nodes.significant_event: together with Bia bound Prometheus to the rock, in Aeschylus play he speaks harshly while binding Prometheus showing no mercy
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of the Titan Pallas and the Oceanid Styx, brother of Nike, Bia, and Zelus
nodes.symbolism: the raw power that enforces divine authority, strength in service of the ruling order, obedience to sovereignty above compassion
nodes.neumann_archetype: the masculine enforcement principle of the patriarchal sky father

nodes.name: Ourea
nodes.physical_characteristics: the mountains personified as gods, ancient and towering
nodes.significant_event: the mountains as the first children of the earth, providing the dwelling places of the nymphs
nodes.birth_circumstances: children of Gaia without consort, born from the primordial earth
nodes.symbolism: the earth raised toward heaven, the primordial landscape as the body of the Great Mother, mountains as the dwelling of the sacred
nodes.neumann_archetype: the masculine expression of the Great Mother rising toward the sky, the chthonic reaching upward

nodes.name: Oneiros
nodes.physical_characteristics: dark-winged spirits who appear in dreams
nodes.significant_event: the collective spirits of dreams who appear at the gates of ivory (false dreams) and horn (true dreams) in Homers Odyssey
nodes.birth_circumstances: son or sons of Hypnos (Sleep), or children of Nyx
nodes.symbolism: the gateway between waking and sleeping consciousness, the ambiguity of dreams as both truth and illusion, the dual gates of horn and ivory
nodes.neumann_archetype: the spirits of the unconscious that communicate through symbols, the dream as the bridge between the ego and the depths

nodes.name: Momus
nodes.character_trait: critical, mocking, sharp-tongued, truthful through ridicule
nodes.physical_characteristics: sometimes depicted lifting a mask from his face revealing his true nature
nodes.significant_event: criticized Athenas house for not being portable, Poseidons bull for not having horns before its eyes, and Aphrodites sandal for creaking, expelled from Olympus for his constant criticism
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Nyx alone according to Hesiod, twin of the misery goddess Oizys
nodes.symbolism: the critic who finds fault with even divine perfection, satire as a divine function, the necessary voice of dissent
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow trickster who exposes the imperfections of even the highest consciousness

nodes.name: Moros
nodes.domain: doom, fate, death, the allotted end
nodes.physical_characteristics: dark, shadowy personification of impending doom
nodes.significant_event: drives mortals toward their fated death, not even Zeus can alter what Moros has decreed, represents the doom that awaits all
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Nyx alone, or of Nyx and Erebus
nodes.symbolism: the inescapable doom allotted to every mortal, fate as an ending rather than a process, the finality that even the gods cannot evade
nodes.neumann_archetype: the dark masculine aspect of fate, the death principle as an inescapable cosmic law

nodes.name: Ophion
nodes.domain: primordial rule, the cosmic egg, creation
nodes.physical_characteristics: great serpent who was the first ruler of the cosmos
nodes.significant_event: ruled Olympus with Eurynome before being overthrown by Cronus and Rhea, cast into the ocean stream
nodes.birth_circumstances: primordial serpent deity of Pelasgian creation myth
nodes.symbolism: the primordial serpent king of creation, the first cosmic order that must be overthrown for the current world to exist
nodes.neumann_archetype: the uroboric serpent as primordial ruler, the earliest stage of cosmic consciousness that must be surpassed

nodes.name: Morpheus
nodes.domain: dreams, sleep, prophecy through dreams, human form in dreams
nodes.physical_characteristics: winged being who takes any human form in dreams
nodes.significant_event: in Ovids Metamorphoses he takes the form of the dead King Ceyx to appear to his wife Alcyone in a dream, conveying the truth of his shipwreck and death
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Hypnos (Sleep), or of Nyx
nodes.symbolism: the power of dreams to reveal truth through illusion, the human form as the medium of divine communication in sleep
nodes.neumann_archetype: the animus of the dream world, the masculine form-giver within the feminine realm of sleep and the unconscious

nodes.name: Lycurgus
nodes.physical_characteristics: fierce Thracian king who opposed Dionysus
nodes.significant_event: drove Dionysus and his nurses into the sea with an ox-goad, punished with madness by Zeus, in his frenzy he killed his own son mistaking him for a vine, the land became barren until the Edoni killed him
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Dryas, king of the Edoni in Thrace
nodes.symbolism: the fatal consequences of rejecting the Dionysiac, the king who opposes ecstasy and is destroyed, the dry land that needs the wine god
nodes.neumann_archetype: the rigid patriarchal consciousness that refuses the transformative feminine (Dionysiac ecstasy) and is destroyed by its own violence

nodes.name: Olethros
nodes.significant_event: the personification of complete destruction, the final end of all things
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Nyx
nodes.symbolism: total destruction as a cosmic principle, the annihilation that follows upon ruin
nodes.neumann_archetype: the death principle as absolute destruction, the masculine void of total ending

nodes.name: Nomos
nodes.significant_event: personification of the laws and customs that govern Greek society, distinguished from Themis (divine law) as human convention
nodes.symbolism: the human law as distinct from divine law, the customs and conventions that regulate social life, the binding force of tradition
nodes.neumann_archetype: the masculine ordering principle of social convention, law as the human attempt to mirror divine order

nodes.name: Meilichios
nodes.domain: propitiation, appeasement, the gentle side of Zeus, honey
nodes.physical_characteristics: Zeus in his gentle and propitious aspect, often depicted as a kindly bearded figure
nodes.significant_event: worshipped throughout Greece as Zeus Meilichios (the Kindly), received offerings of honey cakes rather than blood sacrifice, often depicted as a great serpent
nodes.symbolism: the terrifying god made gentle through propitiation, divine wrath transformed into kindness, the serpent form of the sky god connecting him to the chthonic
nodes.neumann_archetype: the sky father in his chthonic-benevolent form, the terrible masculine made gentle through the sweetness of the Great Mothers offering (honey)

nodes.name: Kydoimos
nodes.domain: battle confusion, chaos in war, din
nodes.physical_characteristics: spirit of the confusion and din of battle
nodes.significant_event: personification of the madness and confusion that sweeps through combatants in the chaos of melee
nodes.birth_circumstances: son or companion of Ares
nodes.symbolism: the psychological disorientation of close combat, the dissolution of order in the violence of war
nodes.neumann_archetype: the dissolution of masculine consciousness in the chaos of battle, the shadow that devours rational thought in combat

nodes.name: Paean
nodes.domain: healing, praise, thanksgiving, hymns of healing
nodes.physical_characteristics: deity or divine physician, the healer who is praised
nodes.significant_event: healer of the gods on Olympus, cured Ares and Hades of wounds received in battle, his name became a hymn of praise and healing (Io Paean)
nodes.symbolism: healing as a song of praise, the physician whose very name becomes a prayer, gratitude for recovery from illness
nodes.neumann_archetype: the masculine healer whose cure is inseparable from the hymn of praise, healing through the word

nodes.name: Myiagros
nodes.physical_characteristics: fly-catcher deity invoked against pestilent flies
nodes.significant_event: invoked to drive away flies from sacrificial rites and festivals, ensuring purity of offerings
nodes.symbolism: the divine protection against contamination, purity of ritual maintained against the smallest nuisance
nodes.neumann_archetype: the protective masculine that maintains the sacred purity of ritual space

nodes.name: Lelantos
nodes.physical_characteristics: Titan of air and concealment, moving unseen
nodes.significant_event: father of the wind nymph Aura, his subtlety allowed him to move unseen, associated with the hunters skill of stalking prey without being detected
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of the Titans Coeus and Phoebe in some accounts
nodes.symbolism: the unseen dimension of the world, the power of concealment and subtlety, the Titan of that which is present but imperceptible
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow Titan of concealment, the masculine principle of stealth and the invisible

nodes.name: Koalemos
nodes.significant_event: personification of complete stupidity, Aristophanes uses him as a comic figure
nodes.symbolism: foolishness as a divine affliction, stupidity as a cosmic force opposing wisdom
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow of consciousness as total absence of awareness, the anti-hero of the mind

nodes.name: Orthanes
nodes.physical_characteristics: phallic deity associated with fertility rituals
nodes.significant_event: a phallic god or spirit of fertility worshipped in rural areas, associated with Priapus and Dionysus
nodes.birth_circumstances: Patriarch Photius I of Constantinople writes that Orthanes was the son of Hermes and a nymph.
nodes.symbolism: the raw phallic principle of generation, masculine fertility in its most primitive form
nodes.neumann_archetype: the undifferentiated phallic masculine, the raw generative force before cultural elaboration

nodes.name: Prometheus
nodes.physical_characteristics: Titan bound to a rock in the Caucasus, an eagle eating his regenerating liver
nodes.significant_event: stole fire from the gods and gave it to humanity, tricked Zeus with the division of sacrificial meat, punished by being chained to a rock where an eagle ate his liver daily, eventually freed by Heracles
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of the Titan Iapetus and the Oceanid Clymene or Asia
nodes.symbolism: the defiant gift of consciousness to humanity, knowledge gained through divine transgression and eternal suffering, forethought as the defining human capacity
nodes.neumann_archetype: the culture hero who separates from the Great Mother and brings the fire of consciousness to humanity, suffering eternally for this act of liberation

nodes.name: Palici
nodes.domain: geysers, oaths, agriculture, twin gods, Sicily
nodes.physical_characteristics: twin deities born from the earth, associated with geysers and sulphurous pools
nodes.significant_event: sacred oaths were sworn at their volcanic lake in Sicily, perjurers were struck blind, their sulphurous pools served as natural lie detectors
nodes.birth_circumstances: sons of Zeus (or Hephaestus) and the nymph Aetna (or Thalia), born from the earth itself
nodes.symbolism: the volcanic truth that burns liars, oaths sworn on the earths fiery depths, the chthonic twins as agents of truth
nodes.neumann_archetype: the chthonic divine twins born from the Great Mothers volcanic body, truth emerging from the depths of the earth

nodes.name: Pan
nodes.domain: nature, shepherds, wilderness, fertility, music, panic
nodes.character_trait: lustful, musical, playful, terrifying, wild, rustic
nodes.physical_characteristics: goat legs, horns, pointed ears, shaggy-haired, bearded, human torso
nodes.significant_event: pursued the nymph Syrinx who was transformed into reeds from which he made his pipes, caused panic among the Persians at Marathon, shouted that Great Pan is dead during the reign of Tiberius
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Hermes and a daughter of Dryops, or of Hermes and Penelope
nodes.symbolism: untamed nature, the wild instinct, the panic terror of encountering the divine in wilderness, the animality within humanity
nodes.neumann_archetype: the nature god representing the instinctual layer of the psyche, the goat-god of animal vitality and creative wildness

nodes.name: Phobos
nodes.physical_characteristics: personification of fear, depicted on shields and in battle scenes
nodes.significant_event: accompanies Ares on the battlefield spreading panic among warriors, depicted on Agamemnons shield and Heracles shield
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Ares and Aphrodite, brother of Deimos (Terror)
nodes.symbolism: fear as the child of war and desire, panic as a contagious divine force, the flight instinct that overcomes even brave warriors
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow of the masculine warrior, the dissolution of heroic consciousness through fear

nodes.name: Phobetor
nodes.physical_characteristics: takes the form of animals and monsters in nightmares
nodes.significant_event: appears in dreams as terrifying beasts, serpents, and monsters, creating the nightmares that torment sleepers
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Hypnos (Sleep), brother of Morpheus and Phantasos
nodes.symbolism: the bestial content of the unconscious that erupts in sleep, the animal terrors hidden beneath consciousness
nodes.neumann_archetype: the theriomorphic unconscious, the beast-forms of the deep psyche that surface in nightmares

nodes.name: Phantasos
nodes.domain: dreams of inanimate objects, surreal dreams
nodes.physical_characteristics: takes the form of inanimate objects in dreams
nodes.significant_event: appears in dreams as rocks, water, trees, and other lifeless things, creating the surreal landscapes of the dream world
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Hypnos (Sleep), brother of Morpheus and Phobetor
nodes.symbolism: the inanimate dimension of the dream world, the non-human contents of the unconscious, the surreal landscape of sleep
nodes.neumann_archetype: the unconscious as a world of non-human forms, the dream as a landscape of transformed matter

nodes.name: Plutus
nodes.character_trait: generous, blind, indiscriminate in distributing wealth
nodes.physical_characteristics: youthful winged boy, sometimes depicted blind, carrying a cornucopia
nodes.significant_event: blinded by Zeus so he would distribute wealth indiscriminately to both good and bad people, in Aristophanes comedy he is cured of his blindness
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Demeter and the mortal Iasion, conceived in a thrice-ploughed field in Crete
nodes.symbolism: wealth as blind fortune, agricultural abundance as divine gift, the tension between deserved and undeserved prosperity
nodes.neumann_archetype: the child of the earth mother (Demeter) and the mortal sower, wealth as the fruit of the sacred agricultural union

nodes.name: Penthus
nodes.significant_event: personification of the grief that accompanies death and loss
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Erebus and Nyx
nodes.symbolism: sorrow as a cosmic force, the grief that transcends individual mourning and touches the universal
nodes.neumann_archetype: the dark masculine of grief, the shadow of consciousness weighed down by loss

nodes.name: Phanes
nodes.domain: creation, light, the firstborn, the Orphic cosmogony
nodes.physical_characteristics: golden-winged, four-eyed, bisexual deity of dazzling light
nodes.significant_event: emerged from the Cosmic Egg at the beginning of creation and set the cosmos in order, later swallowed by Zeus who thereby absorbed all creation into himself
nodes.birth_circumstances: hatched from the Cosmic Egg laid by Nyx or Chronos in Orphic cosmogony
nodes.symbolism: the first light of creation, the cosmic egg as the origin of all being, the bisexual origin before the differentiation of the sexes, light emerging from the darkness of the egg
nodes.neumann_archetype: the divine child as the first light of consciousness emerging from the uroboric egg, the luminous hermaphrodite before the separation of opposites

nodes.name: Porus
nodes.character_trait: resourceful, abundant, cunning, sleepy when drunk
nodes.physical_characteristics: god or daemon of resourcefulness and plenty
nodes.significant_event: in Platos Symposium he fell asleep drunk at a feast of the gods and was seduced by Penia (Poverty), their union producing Eros (Love)
nodes.birth_circumstances: Porus was the son of the goddess Metis, but his father is unknown.
nodes.symbolism: abundance as the sleeping father of desire, resourcefulness unconscious of its own generativity, plenty that creates love through its own carelessness
nodes.neumann_archetype: the unconscious masculine of abundance whose sleep allows the feminine (Poverty) to generate desire

nodes.name: Phosphorus
nodes.domain: the morning star, Venus at dawn, heralding the day
nodes.physical_characteristics: radiant youth carrying a torch, the morning star personified
nodes.significant_event: identified with the planet Venus as it appears at dawn, the light-bearer who precedes the sun each morning
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Eos (Dawn) and Cephalus, or of Atlas, brother of Hesperus
nodes.symbolism: the star that announces the coming day, hope preceding fulfillment, the light before the light, the herald of solar consciousness
nodes.neumann_archetype: the masculine herald of consciousness, the animus who precedes the full light of solar awareness

nodes.name: Perses
nodes.domain: destruction, sacking of cities, the Titan of devastation
nodes.significant_event: father of Hecate by the Titaness Asteria, fought against the Olympians in the Titanomachy and was imprisoned in Tartarus
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of the Titans Crius and Eurybia, brother of Astraeus and Pallas
nodes.symbolism: the destructive Titan whose daughter (Hecate) is honored even by the new gods, destruction as a cosmic principle that generates the goddess of magic
nodes.neumann_archetype: the destroying Titan whose offspring mediates between the old and new orders

nodes.name: Polemos
nodes.significant_event: personification of warfare itself, the cosmic principle of armed conflict
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Eris in some traditions, or a separate deity
nodes.symbolism: war as a divine force beyond human control, the spirit of battle that drives nations to conflict
nodes.neumann_archetype: the destructive masculine as the spirit of war itself, the archetype of conflict

nodes.name: Ponos
nodes.physical_characteristics: spirit of hard labor and toilsome suffering
nodes.significant_event: the personification of the hard labor that wears down mortal life, one of the hardships born of Strife
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Eris (Strife)
nodes.symbolism: the divine weight of toil, labor as a cosmic burden placed upon humanity, the pain of work that sustains life
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow of the culture heros gift, labor as the price consciousness pays for its existence

nodes.name: Philomelus
nodes.domain: agriculture, ploughing, the plough, the constellation Bootes
nodes.significant_event: invented the plough and the ox-drawn wagon, placed among the stars as the constellation Bootes (the Ploughman) by Demeter
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Demeter and the mortal Iasion
nodes.symbolism: the divine origin of agriculture, the plough as the tool that transforms wild nature into cultivated civilization, the farmer elevated to the stars
nodes.neumann_archetype: the masculine culture hero who develops the tool (plough) that transforms the body of the Great Mother (earth) into productive fields

nodes.name: Pothos
nodes.physical_characteristics: winged god of sexual longing and desire for the absent
nodes.significant_event: one of the Erotes, specifically representing the longing for someone absent, distinguished from Eros (desire for the present) and Himeros (desire upon seeing)
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Aphrodite, or brother of Eros and Himeros
nodes.symbolism: desire for what is not present, the ache of absence, longing as the deepest form of love, the pain of separation
nodes.neumann_archetype: the masculine principle of longing, desire as the pull of consciousness toward the absent feminine

nodes.name: Priapus
nodes.domain: fertility, gardens, livestock, male sexuality, abundance
nodes.physical_characteristics: permanently erect oversized phallus, often depicted as a rustic garden statue
nodes.significant_event: worshipped as a garden guardian whose image warded off thieves and evil spirits, associated with Lampsacus on the Hellespont where his cult was centered
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Dionysus and Aphrodite, cursed by Hera with ugliness and impotence before birth, or born with his condition
nodes.symbolism: the comic and apotropaic phallus, male fertility as both generative and ridiculous, the boundary guardian whose grotesqueness wards off evil
nodes.neumann_archetype: the phallic fertility god as both creative and absurd, the masculine generative principle in its most literal and comic form

nodes.name: Pyroeis
nodes.physical_characteristics: personification of the planet Mars as a fiery wandering star
nodes.significant_event: the red planet personified as a divine being, associated with Ares in Greek astral religion
nodes.birth_circumstances: one of the Astra Planeta, children of Eos and Astraeus
nodes.symbolism: the fiery planet as the martial divine, the wandering fire of war in the heavens
nodes.neumann_archetype: the martial masculine as a celestial wanderer, aggression projected into the cosmic order

nodes.name: Phaenon
nodes.physical_characteristics: personification of the planet Saturn as a brilliant star
nodes.significant_event: one of the five Astra Planeta (Wandering Stars), children of Eos and Astraeus
nodes.symbolism: the wandering star as divine being, the planets as gods moving through the fixed heavens
nodes.neumann_archetype: the planetary masculine as a wandering light of consciousness against the fixed background of the cosmic order

nodes.name: Planetae
nodes.significant_event: the five visible planets (Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn) personified as wandering divine beings moving against the fixed stars
nodes.birth_circumstances: children of Eos (Dawn) and Astraeus (Stars)
nodes.symbolism: the divine wanderers who move through the heavens on their own paths, celestial freedom against the fixed order, the planets as gods in motion
nodes.neumann_archetype: the individual lights of consciousness moving independently through the greater cosmic order

nodes.name: Silenus
nodes.character_trait: wise, drunken, prophetic, jovial, cowardly, truthful when captured
nodes.physical_characteristics: fat, bald, snub-nosed old man with horse ears and tail, usually drunk and riding a donkey
nodes.significant_event: captured by King Midas and revealed that the best thing for mortals is never to be born and the second best is to die soon, tutored the young Dionysus
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Pan or Hermes, raised as tutor and foster father of Dionysus
nodes.symbolism: wisdom hidden in apparent foolishness, the truth that emerges from drunkenness, the comic exterior concealing profound knowledge
nodes.neumann_archetype: the wise old man archetype in his comic and intoxicated aspect, the tutor who imparts forbidden knowledge through apparent foolishness

nodes.name: Zagreus
nodes.domain: death and rebirth, the Orphic Mysteries, wine, hunting, dismemberment
nodes.physical_characteristics: the first Dionysus, often depicted as a horned child or bull-formed god
nodes.significant_event: as an infant he was lured away by the Titans with toys and a mirror, dismembered and devoured by them, his heart was saved by Athena and from it Zeus created the second Dionysus (son of Semele), the Titans were destroyed by Zeus thunderbolt and from their ashes humanity was created
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Zeus in serpent form and Persephone, born in the underworld
nodes.symbolism: the god dismembered and reborn, the divine spark within humanity (from the Titans who ate him), the mirror of self-knowledge, death as the prerequisite for cosmic rebirth
nodes.neumann_archetype: the archetypal dying-and-rising god, the divine child dismembered by the Titans (the devouring old order) whose heart (consciousness) survives to be reborn, and whose substance generates a new humanity

nodes.name: Zelus
nodes.physical_characteristics: winged spirit of dedication and rivalry
nodes.significant_event: stood alongside Zeus during the Titanomachy as one of the four winged enforcers, personifies the burning dedication and zeal of the devoted
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Pallas (Titan) and Styx, brother of Nike (Victory), Kratos (Strength), and Bia (Force)
nodes.symbolism: the burning dedication that drives achievement, zeal as a cosmic force alongside victory, strength, and force, the rivalry that spurs excellence
nodes.neumann_archetype: the masculine dedication of consciousness, the burning zeal that drives the ego toward its goals

nodes.name: Telesphorus
nodes.domain: healing, convalescence, recovery, the divine child
nodes.physical_characteristics: small hooded boy, often depicted as a child wrapped in a cloak
nodes.significant_event: worshipped at healing temples (Asklepieia) as the spirit of recovery, small statues of him were dedicated by those who had been healed
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Asclepius in some traditions, or an aspect of the healing power of sleep
nodes.symbolism: recovery as a mystery wrapped in a cloak, the healing that happens during sleep, the divine child who brings convalescence
nodes.neumann_archetype: the divine child of the Great Healer, the small hidden one whose mystery is the restoration of health

nodes.name: Trophonius
nodes.domain: oracles, the underworld, earth mysteries, healing through incubation
nodes.physical_characteristics: underground oracle figure, associated with a cave sanctuary
nodes.significant_event: built a temple and was swallowed by the earth, became an oracle god whose consultation required an elaborate terrifying descent into his underground cave at Lebadeia, those who consulted him emerged changed forever
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Apollo or of Erginus king of Orchomenus, brother of Agamedes
nodes.symbolism: the terrifying oracle of the earth, the descent into the underworld for knowledge, the transformative terror of encountering the chthonic divine
nodes.neumann_archetype: the swallowed hero who becomes the chthonic oracle, consciousness that descends into the Great Mothers body to gain terrible knowledge

nodes.name: Serapis
nodes.domain: death, rebirth, the underworld, fertility, healing
nodes.object: staff with serpent, grain measure, scepter
nodes.physical_characteristics: composite deity combining Osiris and Apis, depicted with a Greek figure bearing an Egyptian crown with a grain basket (modius) on his head
nodes.significant_event: Ptolemy I established his cult to unite Greek and Egyptian worship in Alexandria, his cult spread throughout the Roman Empire, his temple the Serapeum at Alexandria was a wonder of the ancient world
nodes.birth_circumstances: syncretic god created in Ptolemaic Egypt combining Egyptian Osiris-Apis with Greek Hades and Asclepius
nodes.symbolism: the syncretic union of Greek and Egyptian religion, divine kingship over death and rebirth, healing and fertility united in one universal god
nodes.neumann_archetype: the Great Father combining the Egyptian dying-and-rising god with the Greek lord of the underworld, the syncretic resolution of two great religious traditions

nodes.name: Váli
nodes.significant_event: Váli grew to full adulthood within one day of his birth, and slew Höðr before going on to Loki.
nodes.birth_circumstances: In Norse mythology, Váli (Old Norse) or Boe or Bous (Latin) is a god and the son of the god Odin and Rindr (who is either a goddess herself or a human princess, depending on the sources).

nodes.name: Sangarius
nodes.significant_event: father of Nana who conceived Attis by placing a pomegranate against her womb, his river flooded in anger or grief in the myth of Attis and Cybele
nodes.birth_circumstances: son of Oceanus and Tethys
nodes.symbolism: the Phrygian river as the father of the Great Mothers beloved, the river that floods with grief, the watery masculine in the service of the Great Goddess
nodes.neumann_archetype: the river father whose daughter generates the dying-and-rising god (Attis) of the Great Mother

nodes.name: Uranus
nodes.domain: sky, creation, heavens, the starry vault
nodes.character_trait: tyrannical, suppressive, fearful of offspring, generative
nodes.physical_characteristics: the vast sky itself, arching over the earth, sometimes depicted as a giant
nodes.significant_event: mated with Gaia to produce the Titans, Cyclopes, and Hecatoncheires, imprisoned his monstrous children in Tartarus, castrated by his son Cronus with a sickle provided by Gaia
nodes.birth_circumstances: born from Gaia alone, or self-generated as the primordial sky
nodes.symbolism: the primal sky father, the tyrannical suppression of creativity that must be overthrown for creation to proceed, the separation of heaven and earth
nodes.neumann_archetype: the primordial sky father who must be castrated for the world to emerge from the undifferentiated uroboric state

nodes.name: Šanta
nodes.domain: pestilence, illness, divine punishment, Hittite-Greek syncretism
nodes.physical_characteristics: plague deity of Anatolian origin adopted into Greek tradition
nodes.significant_event: associated with the transmission of plague and its divine cure, reflecting the Anatolian layer of Apollos plague and healing functions
nodes.birth_circumstances: Luwian/Hittite deity later syncretized with Apollo in his plague-sending aspect
nodes.symbolism: the foreign origin of Apollos plague function, the god who both sends and cures disease, the Anatolian roots of Greek religion
nodes.neumann_archetype: the terrible masculine as the sender of plague, the destructive aspect of the solar god rooted in pre-Greek Anatolian religion

nodes.name: Thrasos
nodes.physical_characteristics: spirit of boldness and audacious courage
nodes.significant_event: personification of the daring that drives heroes to great deeds but also to reckless disaster
nodes.symbolism: the double-edged nature of boldness, the courage that both creates and destroys heroes, audacity as both virtue and flaw
nodes.neumann_archetype: the masculine drive of consciousness toward risk, the daring that both elevates and destroys

nodes.name: Soter
nodes.physical_characteristics: savior deity, an epithet of Zeus and other gods in their protective aspect
nodes.significant_event: worshipped as Zeus Soter (Zeus the Savior) and Athena Soteira throughout Greece, libations poured to Zeus Soter at the third cup of the symposium
nodes.symbolism: divine salvation and protection, the gods in their capacity as saviors and preservers of mortals, the third libation as the perfect number of salvation
nodes.neumann_archetype: the positive masculine as the protective and saving principle, the sky father in his benevolent guardian aspect

nodes.name: Pyrrhichos
nodes.domain: war dance, Spartan military training, wine
nodes.physical_characteristics: deity or hero associated with the pyrrhic war dance
nodes.significant_event: credited with inventing the pyrrhiche (armed war dance) performed by Spartan warriors before battle
nodes.symbolism: the fusion of dance and warfare, martial training as a sacred art, the war dance as preparation for battle
nodes.neumann_archetype: the masculine ritual that transforms the body into a weapon through rhythmic movement

nodes.name: Theandrios
nodes.domain: heroism, divinity, the Trojan War, Aeolian cult
nodes.physical_characteristics: hero or minor deity worshipped in the Aeolian region
nodes.significant_event: worshipped as a local hero-god in the Aeolian Greek communities
nodes.symbolism: the divine man, the hero elevated to godhood in local cult
nodes.neumann_archetype: the hero who has crossed the threshold into the divine

nodes.name: Tychon
nodes.significant_event: associated with the phallic cults of rural Greece, a companion of Dionysus and Priapus
nodes.symbolism: the rustic phallic principle of agricultural fertility, the generative force of the countryside
nodes.neumann_archetype: the undifferentiated phallic masculine of the fields, the raw generative principle in rustic religion

nodes.name: Syceus
nodes.domain: fig trees, agriculture, the primordial fig
nodes.physical_characteristics: giant who was transformed into a fig tree
nodes.significant_event: fled from the Giants war against the gods and his mother Gaia hid him by transforming him into a fig tree
nodes.birth_circumstances: one of the Giants who warred against the gods
nodes.symbolism: the sacred fig as a transformed giant, the Great Mothers protection of her monstrous children through botanical transformation, the fruit-bearing tree as a hidden rebel
nodes.neumann_archetype: the Great Mothers chthonic son hidden in the form of the nourishing tree, the rebellious masculine absorbed back into the vegetative mother

nodes.name: Sosipolis
nodes.domain: protection of children, the city, serpent cults, Elis
nodes.physical_characteristics: divine child who appeared as a serpent
nodes.significant_event: during a battle between the Eleans and Arcadians his mother placed her infant before the Elean army, the child transformed into a serpent and routed the Arcadians, worshipped at Elis with a serpent cult
nodes.birth_circumstances: His mother was the childbirth-goddess Eileithyia, daughter of Zeus and Hera.
nodes.symbolism: the divine child whose transformation saves the city, the serpent as the protective chthonic power, the infant as weapon of divine defense
nodes.neumann_archetype: the divine child who manifests the chthonic serpent power of the Great Mother to protect the community

nodes.name: Sirius
nodes.domain: the dog star, drought, fever, summer heat
nodes.physical_characteristics: the brightest star in the sky, depicted as a brilliant fiery figure
nodes.significant_event: his rising with the sun in midsummer brings the dog days of heat, drought, and fever, the Athenians sacrificed to him to avert the worst of the summer heat
nodes.birth_circumstances: sometimes described as the hound of Orion placed among the stars
nodes.symbolism: the scorching celestial fire that brings summer fever, the boundary between the beneficent and destructive aspects of stellar light
nodes.neumann_archetype: the burning masculine of the sky at its most intense, the solar principle pushed to destructive excess

nodes.name: Tritopatores
nodes.domain: ancestral spirits, wind spirits, fertility, the dead
nodes.physical_characteristics: three ancestral wind spirits associated with generation and the dead
nodes.significant_event: invoked in marriage ceremonies and rituals concerning the dead, they were the first ancestors from whom all Athenians descended, associated with both generation and funerary rites
nodes.birth_circumstances: father: Helios; mother: Gaia
nodes.symbolism: the ancestral spirits who connect the living with the dead, the wind as the breath of the ancestors, generation as the continuation of ancestral life
nodes.neumann_archetype: the tripled ancestral masculine, the wind-fathers who blow the breath of life into each new generation

nodes.name: Adrasteia
nodes.physical_characteristics: nymph or goddess associated with inevitability
nodes.significant_event: as a nymph on Crete she nursed the infant Zeus in the Dictean cave alongside Ida, feeding him with goats milk and honey
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Zeus and Ananke, or a Cretan nymph daughter of Melisseus who nursed the infant Zeus
nodes.symbolism: the inescapable nature of divine justice, the nurturing hand that also distributes fate
nodes.neumann_archetype: the nurturing-terrible dual aspect of the Great Mother, she who nurses the divine child and enforces cosmic law

nodes.name: Apate
nodes.physical_characteristics: spirit of deceit and fraud, dark and shadowy
nodes.significant_event: one of the evils released when Pandoras jar was opened, fills the world with deception
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Erebus (Darkness) and Nyx (Night)
nodes.symbolism: deception as a primordial cosmic force, the darkness from which guile springs, fraud as the child of night
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow feminine of deception, the dark aspect of the unconscious that misleads consciousness

nodes.name: Ananke
nodes.physical_characteristics: serpentine figure entwined around the cosmos, or an unbending goddess holding the spindle of fate
nodes.significant_event: in Orphic cosmology, she entwines with Chronos (Time) around the cosmic egg from which all creation emerges
nodes.birth_circumstances: self-generated primordial being, predating the Titans
nodes.symbolism: the absolute compulsion of fate against which even the gods are powerless, necessity as the fundamental law of the cosmos
nodes.neumann_archetype: the primordial feminine as inescapable fate, the uroboric serpent of necessity encircling the cosmos

nodes.name: Achlys
nodes.physical_characteristics: pale, emaciated, weeping, with swollen knees and long fingernails, dust-covered
nodes.significant_event: depicted on the Shield of Heracles as the personification of the death-mist that clouds the eyes of the dying
nodes.symbolism: the mist of death, the final moment before dying, misery as a primordial force
nodes.neumann_archetype: the Terrible Mother in her aspect as the death-mist that devours consciousness

nodes.name: Aletheia
nodes.physical_characteristics: depicted as a naked woman representing truth unadorned
nodes.significant_event: Plutarch describes her as the nurturer of Apollo, according to philosophical tradition she hides at the bottom of a well
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Zeus according to Pindar
nodes.symbolism: truth as naked and unadorned, the divine quality of sincerity, truth concealed from most mortals
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine as the ground of truth, the light of consciousness as honesty

nodes.name: Aceso
nodes.physical_characteristics: divine healer, one of the healing sisterhood
nodes.significant_event: worshipped alongside her sisters in the cult of Asclepius, represented the process of healing rather than the cure itself
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Asclepius and Epione, sister of Iaso, Hygieia, Panacea, and Aegle
nodes.symbolism: the ongoing process of recovery, healing as gradual restoration rather than sudden cure
nodes.neumann_archetype: the nurturing feminine in her healing aspect, the gentle restoration of wholeness

nodes.name: Alala
nodes.significant_event: invoked by soldiers before battle as the spirit of the battle cry, Pindar addresses her in his work
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Polemos (War)
nodes.symbolism: the primal shout that transforms individuals into warriors, the voice of collective martial fury
nodes.neumann_archetype: the terrible feminine voice that drives men to battle

nodes.name: Aergia
nodes.significant_event: guards the court of Hypnos (Sleep) in the underworld according to Ovid and Statius
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Aether and Gaia
nodes.symbolism: the torpor of inaction, sloth as a cosmic force opposing effort
nodes.neumann_archetype: the regressive pull back toward the uroboric state of unconsciousness

nodes.name: Aidos
nodes.significant_event: according to Hesiod she and Nemesis will abandon humanity in the Iron Age leaving only suffering
nodes.birth_circumstances: One source calls her daughter of Prometheus.
nodes.symbolism: the inner sense of shame that regulates human behavior, the divine quality that distinguishes civilization from barbarism
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine moral conscience, the restraining force of consciousness

nodes.name: Adephagia
nodes.significant_event: worshipped alongside Demeter in Sicyon
nodes.symbolism: abundance tipping into excess, the shadow side of fertility
nodes.neumann_archetype: the devouring aspect of the Great Mother, consumption without limit

nodes.name: Adikia
nodes.physical_characteristics: hideous, ugly woman being beaten by Dike (Justice)
nodes.significant_event: depicted on the Chest of Cypselus being beaten and dragged by Dike
nodes.symbolism: injustice overcome by righteous law, the ugliness of wrongdoing made visible
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow of the cosmic order, injustice as the deformation of the feminine

nodes.name: Amphictyonis
nodes.physical_characteristics: goddess or heroine who oversaw the mixing of wine with water
nodes.significant_event: taught the Greeks to mix wine with water in proper proportions, associated with the Amphictyonic leagues
nodes.symbolism: the civilizing of intoxication through moderation, community formed through shared ritual drinking
nodes.neumann_archetype: the positive feminine that civilizes the raw Dionysiac impulse through proportion and community

nodes.name: Amechania
nodes.domain: helplessness, want of means, lack of resources
nodes.significant_event: listed among the offspring of Nyx or associated with the retinue of Penia (Poverty)
nodes.symbolism: the paralysis of being without resources or options, helplessness as a cosmic condition
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow of the Great Mother as withholding, the state of deprivation

nodes.name: Angelia
nodes.significant_event: associated with divine communication, sometimes identified with Angelos daughter of Zeus and Hera
nodes.symbolism: the transmission of divine will to mortals, the message as a sacred act
nodes.neumann_archetype: the mediating feminine that carries knowledge between realms

nodes.name: Anaideia
nodes.physical_characteristics: personification of shamelessness, the opposite of Aidos
nodes.significant_event: represented the loss of shame in the moral decay of society, the counter-force to Aidos (Modesty)
nodes.symbolism: the absence of shame as a social and cosmic disorder, brazenness as the corruption of the moral order
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow of modesty, the loss of the feminine moral restraint that regulates consciousness

nodes.name: Angelos
nodes.physical_characteristics: became an underworld goddess after her transgression
nodes.significant_event: stole her mother Heras anointments and gave them to Europa, fled to a childbed woman then a corpse procession, purified by the Cabiri and taken to the underworld
nodes.birth_circumstances: In Greek mythology, Angelos () or Angelia (Ἀγγελία) was a daughter of Zeus and Hera.
nodes.symbolism: the divine daughter who transgresses and is cast down, theft of divine beauty leading to underworld exile
nodes.neumann_archetype: the fallen daughter of the Great Mother who descends to the underworld through transgression

nodes.name: Anatole
nodes.physical_characteristics: one of the Horae of the sunrise
nodes.significant_event: presides over the hour of sunrise in the east
nodes.symbolism: the rising of light from the east, the daily renewal of the world
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine principle of daily renewal and awakening

nodes.name: Acte
nodes.significant_event: one of the fifty Nereids, daughters of Nereus
nodes.symbolism: the sacred boundary where sea meets land
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine as the liminal space between elements

nodes.name: Aphaia
nodes.physical_characteristics: Cretan and Aeginetan goddess associated with fertility and the wild
nodes.significant_event: her extant temple on Aegina built c. 500 BCE is one of the best preserved Greek temples, her cult predates the Olympian religion
nodes.symbolism: the pre-Olympian divine feminine surviving in local cult, the island goddess whose temple endures
nodes.neumann_archetype: the ancient Great Goddess persisting in local cult despite Olympian overlay

nodes.name: Asia
nodes.physical_characteristics: Oceanid nymph who gave her name to the continent of Asia
nodes.significant_event: mother of the Titans who shaped human destiny: Prometheus (forethought), Epimetheus (afterthought), Atlas (endurance), and Menoetius (recklessness)
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Oceanus and Tethys, wife of Iapetus, mother of Prometheus, Atlas, Epimetheus
nodes.symbolism: the eastern lands as the source of the Titan lineage, the maternal ocean from which the shapers of humanity spring
nodes.neumann_archetype: the Oceanic Mother whose children define the human condition

nodes.name: Ate
nodes.physical_characteristics: swift-footed, walks over the heads of men without touching the ground
nodes.significant_event: deceived Zeus into swearing an oath that allowed Eurystheus to be born before Heracles, Zeus cast her out of Olympus and she now walks among mortals causing ruin
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Zeus according to Homer, or daughter of Eris according to Hesiod
nodes.symbolism: the blindness that precedes catastrophe, the divine delusion that even the gods are subject to, reckless folly as a cosmic force
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow feminine that clouds consciousness and leads to destruction through blindness

nodes.name: Bia
nodes.character_trait: forceful, relentless, unyielding, obedient to Zeus
nodes.physical_characteristics: powerful divine figure, companion of Kratos at Zeus command
nodes.significant_event: together with Kratos she bound Prometheus to the rock in the Caucasus on Zeus orders, as depicted in Aeschylus Prometheus Bound
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of the Titan Pallas and the Oceanid Styx, sister of Nike, Kratos, and Zelus
nodes.symbolism: raw force in service of cosmic order, power without mercy, the enforcement of divine will
nodes.neumann_archetype: the instrumental force of the patriarchal order, power serving the sky fathers authority

nodes.name: Ariadne
nodes.physical_characteristics: beautiful Cretan princess, later divine consort crowned with stars
nodes.significant_event: gave Theseus a ball of thread to navigate the Labyrinth and slay the Minotaur, abandoned by Theseus on Naxos, rescued and married by Dionysus who placed her crown among the stars as Corona Borealis
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of King Minos of Crete and Pasiphae, granddaughter of Helios
nodes.symbolism: the feminine wisdom that provides the thread of consciousness through the labyrinth, abandonment transformed into divine union, the mortal bride of the god
nodes.neumann_archetype: the anima figure who enables the heros journey through the labyrinth, later elevated to divine status through union with Dionysus

nodes.name: Benthesikyme
nodes.physical_characteristics: sea goddess of the deep waves
nodes.significant_event: raised the young Eumolpus after his father Poseidon saved him from drowning, she adopted and raised him in Ethiopia
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Poseidon and Amphitrite
nodes.symbolism: the nurturing depths of the sea, the deep waves that carry and sustain rather than destroy
nodes.neumann_archetype: the positive oceanic mother who nurtures the abandoned child in the depths

nodes.name: Bendis
nodes.domain: moon, hunt, wild nature, Thracian mysteries
nodes.physical_characteristics: Thracian goddess of the hunt, depicted with two spears and a torch, sometimes on horseback
nodes.significant_event: introduced to Athens after the Battle of Marathon, worshipped with nocturnal rites, associated with Artemis and Hecate in the Greek world
nodes.birth_circumstances: Thracian goddess adopted into Greek worship
nodes.symbolism: the foreign huntress goddess assimilated into Greek religion, the nocturnal hunt as sacred ritual, Thracian wildness
nodes.neumann_archetype: the foreign face of the Great Goddess (Artemis/Hecate) imported from the northern wild

nodes.name: Brimo
nodes.domain: death, the underworld, Hecate, nighttime rites
nodes.physical_characteristics: dark underworld goddess, an epithet or aspect of Hecate or Persephone
nodes.significant_event: identified with Hecate in the Thessalian tradition, invoked in necromantic and chthonic rites
nodes.symbolism: the terrible goddess of the underworld, the wrathful face of the feminine in the realm of death
nodes.neumann_archetype: the Terrible Mother in her underworld aspect, the dark face of the lunar goddess

nodes.name: Aura
nodes.domain: breeze, dawn air, the morning wind, virginity
nodes.character_trait: wild, virginal, swift, cruel when maddened
nodes.physical_characteristics: swift, wild maiden of the breezes, daughter of a Titan
nodes.significant_event: mocked Artemis virginity saying Artemis must secretly be unchaste, Artemis had Dionysus drive her mad, in her madness she killed her twin sons and was transformed into a spring
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of the Titan Lelantos and the nymph Periboea (or Cybele)
nodes.symbolism: the danger of mocking the divine, the wind as both gentle and destructive, virginity as a serious sacred state not to be questioned
nodes.neumann_archetype: the wild feminine punished for challenging the Great Goddess, madness as the price of transgression against the sacred feminine

nodes.name: Arae
nodes.physical_characteristics: spirits of curses invoked against wrongdoers
nodes.significant_event: invoked in oaths and curses, closely related to the Erinyes
nodes.symbolism: the binding power of spoken curses, words as weapons of divine justice
nodes.neumann_archetype: the terrible feminine voice that binds and punishes through spoken word

nodes.name: Arke
nodes.physical_characteristics: winged goddess, rainbow-like, twin sister of Iris
nodes.significant_event: sided with the Titans against the Olympians during the Titanomachy, while her sister Iris sided with Zeus. Punished by having her wings torn off
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of the sea god Thaumas and the Oceanid Electra, twin sister of Iris
nodes.symbolism: the cost of choosing the wrong side in cosmic conflict, loyalty and betrayal as twin choices, the fallen messenger
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow twin of the divine messenger, the fallen feminine who chose the old order over the new

nodes.name: Apheleia
nodes.physical_characteristics: personification of simplicity and the absence of luxury
nodes.significant_event: mentioned by Aristophanes as a companion of Aphrodite
nodes.symbolism: beauty in simplicity, the rejection of excess, the virtue of plain contentment
nodes.neumann_archetype: the positive feminine in her unadorned natural aspect

nodes.name: Astrape and Bronte
nodes.physical_characteristics: twin goddesses of lightning and thunder
nodes.significant_event: personifications of lightning flash (Astrape) and thunder crash (Bronte), attendants of Zeus wielding the storm
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughters or attendants of Zeus
nodes.symbolism: the twin phenomena of the storm separated into divine agents, the flash and the roar as distinct divine beings
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine storm powers serving the sky father, the terrible feminine voices of the heavens

nodes.name: Asteria
nodes.domain: stars, falling stars, the island of Delos, prophetic dreams
nodes.physical_characteristics: Titaness who transformed into a quail and then a floating island
nodes.significant_event: transformed herself into a quail to escape Zeus pursuit, then leaped into the sea and became the floating island of Ortygia (later Delos) where her sister Leto gave birth to Apollo and Artemis
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of the Titans Coeus and Phoebe, sister of Leto
nodes.symbolism: self-transformation as escape from divine pursuit, the island born from the divine feminines self-sacrifice, providing refuge when all other lands refused
nodes.neumann_archetype: the protective sister who becomes the ground (island) upon which the new consciousness (Apollo) can be born

nodes.name: Aulis
nodes.physical_characteristics: nymph who gave her name to the port of Aulis
nodes.significant_event: the port named after her was where the Greek fleet gathered before sailing to Troy, and where Iphigenia was sacrificed
nodes.birth_circumstances: Aulis was a daughter of King Ogyges of Boeotia.
nodes.symbolism: the gathering point before the great venture, the harbor of decision and sacrifice
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine place of departure, the harbor-nymph who witnesses the sacrifice demanded by the Great Goddess (Artemis)

nodes.name: Calliste
nodes.physical_characteristics: sea nymph of great beauty, daughter of Triton
nodes.significant_event: given to the Argonauts as a clod of earth by her father Triton, the clod later transformed into the island Calliste (Thera/Santorini)
nodes.birth_circumstances: In Greek mythology, Calliste or Callistis () is the daughter of the sea-god Triton and the Libya of Egypt, who was given to the Argonauts as a clod of earth that transformed into the island Calliste.
nodes.symbolism: the gift that transforms into a new land, beauty as the genesis of place
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine as generative of new land, the clod of earth as the Great Mothers creative potential

nodes.name: Arctus
nodes.physical_characteristics: one of the Horae associated with celestial time
nodes.significant_event: presides over a specific hour of the day
nodes.symbolism: the ordered progression of time through the day
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine ordering of temporal existence

nodes.name: Auge
nodes.physical_characteristics: one of the Horae associated with the first light of dawn
nodes.significant_event: presides over the hour of first light
nodes.symbolism: the initial glimmer of consciousness each morning, dawn as awakening
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine dawn of consciousness emerging from the night of the unconscious

nodes.name: Auxesia
nodes.significant_event: worshipped alongside Damia in Epidaurus and Aegina, their statues caused a war between Athens and Aegina when Athens tried to seize them
nodes.symbolism: the increase of vegetation in spring, growth as a sacred power, the local goddess whose statue cannot be taken
nodes.neumann_archetype: the vegetation aspect of the Great Mother, the feminine power of spring increase

nodes.name: Caryatis
nodes.physical_characteristics: nymph associated with the walnut tree
nodes.significant_event: Artemis Caryatis was worshipped at Caryae in Laconia where maidens danced in her honor, the Caryatids (pillar-maidens) are named after these dancers
nodes.symbolism: the maiden who becomes a pillar, the dance of worship transformed into architecture, the walnut tree as sacred feminine
nodes.neumann_archetype: the dancing maiden who becomes the architectural support, the feminine as the pillar of the temple

nodes.name: Charites
nodes.domain: grace, beauty, charm, creativity, festivity, dance
nodes.physical_characteristics: three beautiful maidens dancing together, often naked or lightly draped
nodes.significant_event: attend Aphrodite and adorn her, inspire artists and poets, preside over banquets and social gatherings
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughters of Zeus and the Oceanid Eurynome: Aglaea (Splendor), Euphrosyne (Joy), and Thalia (Good Cheer)
nodes.symbolism: the grace that makes life beautiful, the interconnection of beauty, joy, and creativity, the social bonds that make civilization pleasant
nodes.neumann_archetype: the positive transformative feminine as the inspiration of all art and social harmony

nodes.name: Eiresione
nodes.physical_characteristics: olive or laurel branch wreathed in wool and hung with fruits and small vessels
nodes.significant_event: carried in procession during the Pyanopsia and Thargelia festivals, hung on doors as a charm for abundance
nodes.symbolism: the olive branch as prayer for abundance, the decorated branch as a bridge between human need and divine generosity
nodes.neumann_archetype: the sacred branch as the connection between the earth mother and human sustenance

nodes.name: Dione
nodes.domain: fertility, prophecy, the oracle at Dodona, the sky
nodes.physical_characteristics: ancient Titaness or Oceanid, consort of Zeus at Dodona
nodes.significant_event: worshipped alongside Zeus at the oracle of Dodona as his original consort before Hera, in Homers Iliad she comforts Aphrodite who is her daughter
nodes.birth_circumstances: either a Titaness daughter of Uranus and Gaia, or an Oceanid daughter of Oceanus and Tethys
nodes.symbolism: the ancient feminine counterpart of Zeus predating the Olympian order, the oracle as feminine wisdom, the sky goddess whose name is the feminine form of Zeus
nodes.neumann_archetype: the ancient Great Mother who was the original consort of the sky father before being displaced by the Olympian order

nodes.name: Eleutheria
nodes.physical_characteristics: personification of liberty, depicted wearing a liberty cap or pileus
nodes.significant_event: worshipped with Zeus Eleutherios (Zeus the Liberator) after the Persian Wars, had a stoa in the Athenian Agora
nodes.birth_circumstances: Hyginus describes Eleutheria as a daughter of Zeus and Hera.
nodes.symbolism: political freedom as a divine gift, liberty as a sacred feminine quality earned through struggle
nodes.neumann_archetype: the liberating feminine that frees consciousness from bondage

nodes.name: Doris
nodes.domain: sea bounty, the mixing of fresh and salt water, fish
nodes.physical_characteristics: Oceanid goddess of the rich fishing grounds where rivers meet the sea
nodes.significant_event: married the sea god Nereus and bore the fifty Nereids, the gentle sea nymphs
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Oceanus and Tethys
nodes.symbolism: the bounty of the sea where fresh water meets salt, the fertile mixing zone, the oceanic mother of gentle sea spirits
nodes.neumann_archetype: the positive oceanic mother whose union with the Old Man of the Sea produces the benign feminine spirits of the ocean

nodes.name: Despoina
nodes.domain: mysteries, the underworld, nature, the Arcadian cult
nodes.physical_characteristics: veiled goddess whose true name was forbidden to the uninitiated, depicted with bull and human heads
nodes.significant_event: worshipped in secret mysteries at Lycosura in Arcadia, her true name could not be spoken by the uninitiated, her cult statue was made by Damophon
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Demeter and Poseidon, conceived when Poseidon ravished Demeter in horse form, sister of the horse Arion
nodes.symbolism: the hidden name of the divine feminine, the mysteries that must not be spoken, the daughter born from the union of earth and sea
nodes.neumann_archetype: the hidden aspect of the Great Mother whose true identity is itself the mystery, the forbidden name of the feminine divine

nodes.name: Ceto
nodes.domain: sea monsters, the dangers of the deep, primordial sea
nodes.character_trait: monstrous, ancient, beautiful yet terrible, generative of horrors
nodes.physical_characteristics: primordial sea goddess, sometimes described as beautiful with golden scales, mother of monsters
nodes.significant_event: with her brother-husband Phorcys she bore Medusa, the Graeae, Echidna, Ladon the serpent, and Scylla, populating the sea with terrors
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Pontus (Sea) and Gaia (Earth)
nodes.symbolism: the sea as source of horror and wonder, the beautiful mother who generates monsters, the primordial depths from which terrors emerge
nodes.neumann_archetype: the Terrible Mother of the sea whose beautiful surface conceals monstrous depths

nodes.name: Dyssebeia
nodes.physical_characteristics: spirit of impiety, the opposite of Eusebeia
nodes.significant_event: personification of the refusal to honor the gods, associated with moral decay
nodes.birth_circumstances: I have a timely word of advice: arrogance (hybris) is truly the child of impiety (dyssebia), but from health of soul comes happiness, dear to all, much prayed for.
nodes.symbolism: the rejection of sacred obligations, the root of civilizational decay in Greek thought
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow of the sacred, the refusal of consciousness to acknowledge the numinous

nodes.name: Ekecheiria
nodes.physical_characteristics: personification of the sacred truce, depicted in statuary at Olympia
nodes.significant_event: embodied the sacred truce (ekecheiria) that protected travelers attending the Olympic Games, her statue stood at Olympia crowning Iphitos
nodes.symbolism: the sacred pause in warfare for divine celebration, peace as a temporary but inviolable divine command
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine principle of cessation that halts masculine warfare for the sake of the sacred

nodes.name: Charis
nodes.physical_characteristics: divine embodiment of grace and charm
nodes.significant_event: married to Hephaestus the smith god, welcoming Thetis when she came to request armor for Achilles
nodes.birth_circumstances: in some traditions the wife of Hephaestus, in others identical with Aglaea the youngest of the Charites
nodes.symbolism: grace united with craft, beauty as the companion of creative labor, charm as a divine quality
nodes.neumann_archetype: the positive anima as the grace that accompanies and completes the creative masculine

nodes.name: Chloris
nodes.domain: spring, flowers, new growth, the color green
nodes.physical_characteristics: goddess of flowers and spring, identified with Roman Flora
nodes.significant_event: transformed from the nymph Chloris into the goddess Flora by Zephyrus who married her, given dominion over all flowers
nodes.birth_circumstances: nymph who was abducted by Zephyrus the west wind
nodes.symbolism: the greening of the world in spring, the nymphs transformation through the touch of the west wind, flowers as the adornment of the earth
nodes.neumann_archetype: the positive transformative feminine, the maiden transformed by the masculine wind into the goddess of flowering

nodes.name: Camarina
nodes.domain: lakes, marshes, local cult, Camarina city
nodes.physical_characteristics: nymph of the lake near the city of Camarina in Sicily
nodes.significant_event: the citizens were warned by an oracle not to drain her swamp, they did so anyway and invaders used the dry approach to sack the city
nodes.birth_circumstances: In Greek mythology, Camarina () was an Oceanid, as a daughter of the Titan of the Sea, Oceanus, possibly by his sister-wife Tethys.
nodes.symbolism: the sacred that must not be disturbed, the marsh as divine protection, the fatal consequences of ignoring oracular warnings
nodes.neumann_archetype: the protective feminine in her stagnant-water aspect, the marsh-mother whose removal exposes the community to destruction

nodes.name: Dysis
nodes.physical_characteristics: Hora of sunset and the west
nodes.significant_event: presides over the hour of sunset
nodes.symbolism: the closing of the day, the descent of light into darkness, the western gate of the sun
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine threshold between day and night, consciousness descending toward sleep

nodes.name: Elete
nodes.significant_event: presides over the first afternoon hour
nodes.symbolism: the hour of prayer as a sacred pause in the day, afternoon contemplation
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine ordering of devotional time within the natural day

nodes.name: Eris
nodes.character_trait: contentious, malicious, divisive, but also productive of competition
nodes.physical_characteristics: winged, dark-robed, companion of Ares on the battlefield
nodes.significant_event: threw the golden apple inscribed For the Fairest among the goddesses at the wedding of Peleus and Thetis, triggering the Judgment of Paris and ultimately the Trojan War
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Nyx alone according to Hesiod, or daughter of Zeus and Hera in some traditions
nodes.symbolism: the destructive power of discord that triggers catastrophe, but also the productive rivalry that drives achievement, strife as both curse and creative force
nodes.neumann_archetype: the shadow aspect of the feminine, discord as the force that disrupts the existing order to initiate transformation

nodes.name: Erinyes
nodes.domain: vengeance, blood guilt, torment, the underworld
nodes.physical_characteristics: giant, winged, snake-haired, with bloodshot eyes, carrying torches and whips
nodes.significant_event: pursue and torment those guilty of kin-murder and oath-breaking, hounded Orestes across Greece after he killed his mother
nodes.birth_circumstances: born from the blood of Uranus when Cronus castrated him, or daughters of Nyx
nodes.symbolism: the primordial law of blood vengeance, guilt as an inescapable cosmic force, the ancient chthonic order older than the Olympians
nodes.neumann_archetype: the terrible feminine as agents of the ancient maternal law, the chthonic forces of guilt and retribution

nodes.name: Eos
nodes.object: chariot, rose, tiara, pitcher of dew
nodes.character_trait: beautiful, amorous, eternally renewing, cursed with insatiable desire for mortals
nodes.physical_characteristics: rosy-fingered, saffron-robed, winged, driving a chariot
nodes.significant_event: cursed by Aphrodite with insatiable desire for mortal men after Eos slept with Ares, abducted Tithonus and asked Zeus for his immortality but forgot to ask for eternal youth so he withered into a cicada
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of the Titans Hyperion and Theia, sister of Helios and Selene
nodes.symbolism: the eternal renewal of each new day, the tragedy of immortality without youth, the dawn as the threshold between darkness and light
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine dawn archetype, the seductive goddess whose desire for mortal men represents the pull of consciousness from the unconscious

nodes.name: Graeae
nodes.domain: the gray sea, old age, guardianship, hidden knowledge
nodes.character_trait: gray, ancient, sharing one eye and one tooth, withholding
nodes.physical_characteristics: three old women sharing a single eye and a single tooth between them, gray-haired from birth
nodes.significant_event: Perseus tricked them into revealing the location of the Gorgon Medusa by stealing their shared eye and tooth, refusing to return them until they told him
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughters of Phorcys and Ceto, sisters of the Gorgons: Deino, Enyo, and Pemphredo
nodes.symbolism: shared consciousness (one eye) and shared power (one tooth) among ancient beings, the guardians of terrible secrets who can be tricked, old age as the gateway to hidden knowledge
nodes.neumann_archetype: the Triple Goddess in her Terrible Old Woman aspect, the ancient guardians whose diminished powers still hold the key to the monstrous

nodes.name: Enyo
nodes.domain: war, destruction, sack of cities, bloodshed
nodes.physical_characteristics: goddess of war covered in blood, companion and sister (or mother) of Ares
nodes.significant_event: accompanies Ares on the battlefield, delights in bloodshed and the destruction of cities, depicted at the sack of Troy
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Zeus and Hera, or daughter of Phorcys and Ceto
nodes.symbolism: the feminine face of war as pure destruction, the goddess who embodies the chaos and horror of battle without strategy or glory
nodes.neumann_archetype: the Terrible Mother in her most destructive warrior aspect, the feminine that delights in annihilation

nodes.name: Elpis
nodes.physical_characteristics: young woman, sometimes winged, depicted holding flowers or carrying a cornucopia
nodes.significant_event: remained inside Pandoras jar after all other spirits escaped, debated whether she is a blessing (sustaining mortals) or a curse (deluding them with false expectations)
nodes.symbolism: the ambiguity of hope as both sustaining and deceiving, the one spirit that remains with humanity, the question of whether hope is a gift or the cruelest torment
nodes.neumann_archetype: the ambiguous feminine gift that sustains consciousness even when all other comforts have fled

nodes.name: Ersa
nodes.physical_characteristics: gentle maiden embodying the morning dew
nodes.significant_event: the morning dew personified, nourishing the earth each dawn with gentle moisture
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Zeus and Selene (Moon), or daughter of Eos (Dawn)
nodes.symbolism: the renewal that comes each morning, the gentle moisture that sustains life between night and day, tears of the dawn
nodes.neumann_archetype: the gentle feminine that mediates between the night (unconscious) and day (consciousness) through the gift of moisture

nodes.name: Epione
nodes.significant_event: mother of the entire healing divine family, her name means she who soothes, worshipped alongside Asclepius at Epidaurus
nodes.birth_circumstances: wife of Asclepius, mother of Hygieia, Panacea, Iaso, Aceso, and Aegle
nodes.symbolism: the feminine principle of soothing pain, the mother of the healing arts, gentleness as the foundation of medicine
nodes.neumann_archetype: the nurturing feminine as the source of all healing, the mother whose gentleness generates the entire tradition of medicine

nodes.name: Eurynome
nodes.domain: universal rule, ocean, the primeval queen, joy, meadows
nodes.physical_characteristics: beautiful Oceanid goddess who danced upon the waters of chaos before creation
nodes.significant_event: in Pelasgian myth she danced on the primeval waters and created all things, in Olympian myth she was mother of the Charites (Graces) by Zeus, rescued Hephaestus when he was cast from Olympus
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Oceanus and Tethys, or the primordial goddess who danced on the sea before creation
nodes.symbolism: the dancing feminine that creates through movement, the oceanic mother who nurtures the rejected, the joy that undergirds creation
nodes.neumann_archetype: the primordial Great Mother who creates the world through her dance upon the waters of chaos

nodes.name: Eusebeia
nodes.physical_characteristics: personification of piety and proper reverence toward the gods
nodes.significant_event: the opposite of Dyssebeia (Impiety), embodied the proper relationship between mortals and gods
nodes.birth_circumstances: In other tellings, Dike is the daughter of the god Zeus and/or the goddess Themis (Order).
nodes.symbolism: the virtue of reverence, the proper stance of humanity before the divine, piety as the foundation of civilization
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine consciousness of the sacred, the devotional relationship between the human and the numinous

nodes.name: Enodia
nodes.domain: roads, crossroads, gateways, protection of travelers, the dead
nodes.physical_characteristics: goddess of the roadways, carrying torches and keys, sometimes with dog and horse companions
nodes.significant_event: worshipped throughout Thessaly as a major goddess of crossroads and gateways, closely identified with Hecate, received offerings at entrances and road junctions
nodes.death_circumstances: Timarete of Corinth, who died in Pella, Macedonia, in the late 5th century BC and Chrysame.
nodes.symbolism: the divine protection at liminal spaces, the crossroads as the place of choice and danger, the guardian of transitions
nodes.neumann_archetype: the liminal feminine who guards the thresholds between worlds, the goddess of roads as the paths of the soul

nodes.name: Eucleia
nodes.physical_characteristics: personification of glory and good repute
nodes.significant_event: had a sanctuary at Athens, worshipped as a bride-goddess in Boeotia, associated with Artemis as a goddess of virtue
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Hephaestus and Aglaea in some traditions
nodes.symbolism: moral glory as a divine quality, the good name that outlasts death, virtue as the true source of renown
nodes.neumann_archetype: the positive feminine ideal of moral excellence, virtue as luminous feminine consciousness

nodes.name: Gaia
nodes.animals: serpent, bull, bear, scorpion, cow, centaur
nodes.physical_characteristics: giant earth goddess, rises from the ground, sometimes depicted nursing infants
nodes.significant_event: bore Uranus the sky, the mountains, and the sea without union, held the original oracle at Delphi before Apollo, sent Typhon and the Giants against Zeus
nodes.birth_circumstances: emerged from Chaos at the beginning of creation, self-generated
nodes.symbolism: the living earth as divine maternal body, prophecy arising from the earth itself, the primordial feminine that precedes and encompasses all later deities
nodes.neumann_archetype: the archetypal Great Mother in her most primordial undifferentiated form, containing both creation and destruction

nodes.name: Eupraxia
nodes.physical_characteristics: spirit of right and virtuous action
nodes.significant_event: personification of acting rightly in both civic and moral spheres
nodes.birth_circumstances: According to Aeschylus, Eupraxia was the daughter of another two personifications, Peitharchia and Soter.
nodes.symbolism: the divine quality of right action, virtue expressed through deeds not merely thoughts
nodes.neumann_archetype: the active feminine virtue, consciousness expressed through correct behavior

nodes.name: Eunostus
nodes.physical_characteristics: spirit of orderly and lawful conduct
nodes.significant_event: personification of proper behavior within the bounds of law and custom
nodes.symbolism: the inner disposition toward lawful action, order as a quality of character not merely external compliance
nodes.neumann_archetype: the ordered aspect of consciousness, the internalization of cosmic law

nodes.name: Eulabeia
nodes.physical_characteristics: spirit of discretion and cautious piety
nodes.significant_event: personification of the cautious reverence that prevents transgression against the gods
nodes.symbolism: the virtue of knowing ones limits before the divine, caution born of reverence
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine consciousness of appropriate limitation before the numinous

nodes.name: Eukarpia
nodes.significant_event: presides over the fruitful season of harvest
nodes.symbolism: the divine blessing of a successful harvest, the earth yielding her fruits
nodes.neumann_archetype: the Great Mother in her harvest aspect, the generous yielding of the earth

nodes.name: Genetyllides
nodes.significant_event: worshipped by women in labor, associated with the cults of Aphrodite and Artemis at Brauron
nodes.symbolism: the divine feminine attending the moment of birth, generation as a sacred act requiring divine protection
nodes.neumann_archetype: the positive Great Mother as the attendant spirits of birth, the feminine mystery of generation

nodes.name: Hera
nodes.domain: marriage, women, childbirth, family, sovereignty, sky
nodes.object: pomegranate, scepter, crown, chariot, arrow, spear
nodes.animals: cow, cuckoo, peacock, eagle, serpent, snake, bull, bear, tortoise, crane, minotaur, hydra
nodes.character_trait: jealous, vengeful, regal, protective of marriage, powerful, vindictive
nodes.physical_characteristics: tall, majestic, cow-eyed, beautiful, crowned with a polos or diadem, veiled
nodes.significant_event: persecutes Heracles throughout his life, punishes Zeus many lovers and their children, tricks Zeus with the golden apple, sides against Troy in the Trojan War
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Cronus and Rhea, swallowed by Cronus at birth and later disgorged, sister and wife of Zeus
nodes.symbolism: the sacred institution of marriage, feminine sovereignty and jealous power, the tension between patriarchal rule and the older feminine divine order
nodes.neumann_archetype: the Great Goddess diminished to jealous consort under patriarchal Olympian order, retaining traces of her former sovereignty

nodes.name: Ino
nodes.domain: the sea, Dionysiac cult, nursing, transformation
nodes.physical_characteristics: mortal queen who became a sea goddess, sometimes depicted with a flowing veil
nodes.significant_event: raised the infant Dionysus after Semeles death, maddened by Hera she threw herself and her son Melicertes into the sea, transformed into the sea goddess Leucothea, later saved Odysseus from drowning by lending him her veil
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Cadmus and Harmonia, sister of Semele, wife of King Athamas
nodes.symbolism: the mortal nurse of the god who is transformed through madness and death into a divine protector of sailors, motherly love surviving even death and madness
nodes.neumann_archetype: the Great Mother as nurse who passes through madness and death to become the protective sea goddess, the transformative power of maternal devotion

nodes.name: Horae
nodes.domain: seasons, natural order, justice, peace, good order
nodes.physical_characteristics: beautiful maidens dancing in a circle, sometimes winged, crowned with flowers
nodes.significant_event: guard the gates of Olympus, opening and closing the cloud barrier for the gods, preside over the natural sequence of seasons
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughters of Zeus and Themis
nodes.symbolism: the ordered cycle of seasons as divine law, the connection between natural order and moral order, time as regular rhythm
nodes.neumann_archetype: the feminine as the ordering principle of natural time, the daughters of law who maintain cosmic rhythm

nodes.name: Harmonia
nodes.physical_characteristics: beautiful goddess who brings together opposites
nodes.significant_event: married Cadmus in a wedding attended by all the gods, received a cursed necklace that brought misfortune to all who wore it, transformed into a serpent alongside Cadmus in old age
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Ares (War) and Aphrodite (Love), embodying the union of strife and desire
nodes.symbolism: harmony born from the union of opposites (war and love), the cursed gifts that follow divine marriages, the serpent transformation as return to the primordial
nodes.neumann_archetype: the reconciling feminine born from the union of masculine aggression and feminine desire, the daughter who embodies the resolution of opposites

nodes.name: Hemera
nodes.domain: day, daylight, the sky by day
nodes.physical_characteristics: radiant goddess of the day, embodiment of daylight itself
nodes.significant_event: born from darkness and night, she displaces her mother Nyx each dawn, sweeping away the mists of night and flooding the world with light
nodes.birth_circumstances: daughter of Erebus (Darkness) and Nyx (Night)
